MWI.note: Nothing on consumer protection; the fraud and hotline remarks are GiveDirectly's own.
Payments are GiveDirectly's own NGO programme; the government only helps select areas, so no government payment is stated.
No survey share of adults with an account.

facts.fact: GiveDirectly says it sends unconditional cash transfers of about US$550 per eligible adult to recipients in Malawi by mobile money, with 85,000 adults enrolled and paid in TA Khongoni.

MWI.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
